text.p: BULKERS - Hua Wan - (built 1981) 30,868 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5 million.
Noble Star - (built 1977) 28,637 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $3.6 million "as is".
Golden North - (built 1981) 23,982 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $6.215 million in Durban.
Med Lerici - (built 1973) 23,222 dwt sold to Syrian buyers for $2.5 million.
Linden - (built 1972) 19,717 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $1.5 million.
1,634,000 tonnes TANKERS - Pacifica - (built 1985) 29,979 dwt sold for $15 million.
Mar Sofia - (built 1979) 15,456 dwt sold to European buyers for $4.5 million.
SOLD FOR DEMOLITION - Mare Asia - (built 1973) 268,436 dwt sold to Middle Eastern based cash buyers for $174 per ldt.
Farnes - (built 1975) 173,315 dwt sold to Middle East based buyers for $170 per ldt for sale on to Pakistan buyers.
